title.zh: 卷九 本紀第九 後廢帝
title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九 後廢帝 Volume 9 Annals 9: Emperor Fei II

sentences.zh: 廢帝諱昱，字德融，小字慧震，明帝長子也。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor's taboo name was Yu; his style name was Derong and his childhood name Huizhen. He was the eldest son of Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Fei II, taboo name Yu, style name Derong, childhood name Huizhen, was Emperor Ming's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 大明七年正月辛丑，生於衞尉府。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Daming, on the day xinchou of the first month, he was born in the Chamberlain for the Imperial Clansman's residence.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on xinchou day in the first month of the seventh year of Daming, at the Chamberlain for the Imperial Clansman's residence.

sentences.zh: 太宗諸子在孕，皆以周易筮之，即以所得之卦為小字，故帝字慧震，其餘皇子亦如之。

translations.literal: For all of Emperor Ming's sons while still in the womb, the Classic of Changes was used to divine by hexagram; the hexagram obtained was taken as the childhood name, and so the Emperor's childhood name was Huizhen — the other princes were treated likewise.
translations.idiomatic: While Emperor Ming's sons were still in the womb, each was divined by hexagram with the Classic of Changes, and the resulting hexagram was taken as his childhood name. Hence the emperor received the childhood name Huizhen, and the other princes were treated the same way.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taishi, he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taishi he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 三年，始制太子改名昱。

translations.literal: In the third year, it was first decreed that the crown prince should change his name to Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year a decree first changed the crown prince's name to Yu.

sentences.zh: 安車乘象輅。

translations.literal: He rode the State Coach and the Elephants' Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted use of the State Coach and the Elephants' Carriage.

sentences.zh: 六年，出東宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he moved out of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he left the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 又制太子元正朝賀，服袞冕九章衣。

translations.literal: It was further decreed that at the crown prince's New Year's audience and congratulatory homage he should wear the nine-patterned robes of the dragon robe and coronet.
translations.idiomatic: A further decree specified that at the crown prince's New Year's audience and ceremonial homage he should wear nine-patterned dragon robes and coronet.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年四月己亥，太宗崩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiyu, on the day jihai of the fourth month, Emperor Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming died on jihai day in the fourth month of the first year of Taiyu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太子即皇帝位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the crown prince assumed the imperial throne and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the crown prince took the throne and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 尚書令袁粲、護軍將軍褚淵共輔朝政。

translations.literal: Yuan Can, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, jointly assisted in governing the court.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Can as Director of the Masters of Writing and Chu Yuan as General Who Protects the Army jointly assisted in running the government.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以護軍將軍張永為右光祿大夫，撫軍將軍安成王為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Zhang Yong, General Who Protects the Army, was made Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness; the Prince of Ancheng, General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Inspector of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was appointed Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and the Prince of Ancheng, General Who Pacifies the Army, became Inspector of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 己酉，特進、右光祿大夫劉遵考改為左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Liu Zunkao, Special Advance and Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, was transferred to Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Liu Zunkao, Special Advance and Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, was transferred to Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，以吳興太守張岱為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingsi, Zhang Dai, Administrator of Wuxing, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the fifth month, Wuxing Administrator Zhang Dai was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，緣江戍兵老疾者，悉聽還。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, garrison troops stationed along the river who were aged or infirm were all permitted to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day all aged and infirm garrison troops stationed along the river were permitted to return home.

sentences.zh: 班劍依舊入殿。

translations.literal: Ceremonial swords continued to enter the hall as before.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial sword guard continued to enter the hall as before.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，詔曰：「夫興王經制，實先民隱，方求廣教，刑於四維。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renchen, an edict said: "The founding of a kingship and its enduring statutes truly precede the people's private concerns; one now seeks to extend teaching and impose discipline upon the four corners.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the sixth month an edict declared: "Establishing a kingship and its enduring statutes truly come before the people's private concerns; teaching is now to be broadly extended and discipline imposed upon the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 朕以煢眇，夙膺寶歷，永言民政，未接聽覽，眷言乃顧，無忘鑒寐。

translations.literal: I, solitary and insignificant, have long since received the precious succession. Ever mindful of the people's affairs, I have not yet taken up audiences and review; turning my thoughts back again and again, I forget them neither waking nor in sleep.
translations.idiomatic: I, solitary and insignificant, long since received the precious throne. Though ever mindful of the people's affairs I have not yet taken up audiences, and my concern for them keeps me awake night and day.

sentences.zh: 可遣大使分行四方，觀採風謠，問其疾苦。

translations.literal: Ambassadors may be dispatched to travel separately through the four quarters, observing and gathering folk songs and ballads and inquiring into their hardships and suffering.
translations.idiomatic: Let ambassadors be dispatched through the four quarters to observe folk songs, gather ballads, and inquire into people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 令有咈民，法不便俗者，悉各條奏。

translations.literal: Where there are ordinances that offend the people or laws ill suited to local custom, each shall be listed and reported in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Where ordinances offend the people or laws ill suit local custom, each case shall be reported in full detail.

sentences.zh: 若守宰威恩可紀，廉勤允著，依事騰聞。

translations.literal: If a district magistrate or prefect's authority and kindness deserve record, or his integrity and diligence are truly manifest, report the matter up according to the facts.
translations.idiomatic: If a magistrate or prefect's authority and kindness deserve record, or his integrity and diligence are truly evident, report the matter up accordingly.

sentences.zh: 如獄訟誣枉，職事紕繆，惰公存私，害民利己者，無或隱昧。

translations.literal: If there are false charges and wrongs in prison suits, negligence in official duties, neglect of public for private ends, or harm to the people for personal gain, none of these shall be concealed.
translations.idiomatic: Where prison cases involve false charges, official duties are botched, public office is neglected for private ends, or the people are harmed for personal gain, nothing shall be concealed.

sentences.zh: 廣納芻輿之議，博求獻藝之規。

translations.literal: Broadly accept counsel offered from humble carts, and widely seek proposals for presenting arts and talents.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly accept counsel from common folk and widely seek proposals for presenting talent and skill.

sentences.zh: 巡省之道，務令精洽，深簡行識，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: The way of touring inspection must be made thorough and complete; choose deeply for knowledge of conduct, so that it may be as if I myself were reviewing it.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection tours must be thoroughly executed, with men of deep discernment chosen for the task, so that it is as if I review the results myself.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「夫寢夢期賢，往誥垂美，物色求良，前書稱盛。

translations.literal: " A further edict said: "Dreams in sleep anticipate worthy men; former injunctions have left fine examples; seeking out the good has been praised in earlier writings.
translations.idiomatic: " A further edict declared: "Sleeping dreams anticipate worthy men; former injunctions have left fine examples; seeking out excellence was praised as a flourishing policy in earlier writings.

sentences.zh: 朕以沖昧，嗣膺寶業，思仰述聖猷，勉弘政道，興言多士，常想得人。

translations.literal: I, young and dim, have succeeded to the precious enterprise. I think to follow and set forth the sage plan, striving to expand the way of governance. Speaking of the many scholars, I constantly think of obtaining worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: Young and inexperienced, I have succeeded to the precious throne. I mean to follow the sage plan and strive to expand governance, and in speaking of the many scholars, I constantly long to find the right men.

sentences.zh: 可普下牧守，廣加搜採。

translations.literal: This may be broadly sent down to prefects and governors for wide search and selection.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be sent down to all prefects and governors for wide search and selection.

sentences.zh: 其有孝友聞族，義讓光閭，或匿名屠釣，隱身耕牧，足以整厲澆風，扶益淳化者，凡厥一善，咸無遺逸。

translations.literal: Whoever has filial piety and fraternal affection famed in his clan, righteousness and forbearance shining through his neighborhood, or who hides his name among butchers and anglers or withdraws to farming and herding, yet is sufficient to rectify and inspire a decadent custom and support a pure transformation — every such good quality shall be reported without omission.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever is famed in his clan for filial piety and brotherly love, or whose righteousness and forbearance shine throughout his neighborhood; whoever hides among butchers and fishers or withdraws to farming and herding yet can rectify decadent customs and uphold pure transformation — every such virtue shall be reported without exception.

sentences.zh: 虛輪佇帛，俟聞嘉薦。

translations.literal: Empty wheels await silk offerings; I await news of fine recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: With empty wheels awaiting silk offerings, I await word of worthy recommendations.

sentences.zh: 」京師雨水，詔賑卹二縣貧民。

translations.literal: " In the capital region there was flooding from rain, and an edict ordered relief for the poor in two counties.
translations.idiomatic: " Flooding from rain struck the capital region, and an edict ordered relief for the poor in two counties.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，尊皇后曰皇太后，立皇后江氏。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the empress was honored as empress dowager, and Lady Jiang was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the empress was honored as empress dowager and Lady Jiang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，崇拜帝所生陳貴妃為皇太妃。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuchen, Consort Chen, who bore the Emperor, was honored as grand imperial consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the seventh month of autumn, Consort Chen, the emperor's birth mother, was honored as grand imperial consort.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁亥，罷宋安郡還屬廣興。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day dinghai, Song'an commandery was abolished and returned to affiliation with Guangxing.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the intercalary month Song'an Commandery was abolished and returned to Guangxing.

sentences.zh: 己丑，割南豫州南汝陰郡屬西豫州，西豫州廬江郡屬豫州。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Nanrunyin commandery of Southern Yu Province was detached for Western Yu Province, and Lujiang commandery of Western Yu Province was attached to Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Nanrunyin Commandery was transferred from Southern Yu to Western Yu Province, and Lujiang Commandery was transferred from Western Yu to Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以新除征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史蔡興宗為中書監、光祿大夫，安西將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之為鎮西將軍、荊州刺史，南徐州刺史劉秉為平西將軍、郢州刺史，新除太常建平王景素為鎮軍將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Cai Xingzong, newly relieved as General Who Campaigns against the West, Grand Master with Honors Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness; Shen Youzhi, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province, was made General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Jing Province; Liu Bing, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province; Liu Jingsu, Prince of Jianping and newly relieved as Grand Steward, was made General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Cai Xingzong, who had just been relieved as General Who Campaigns against the West with honors equal to the Three Dukes and as Inspector of Jing Province, was appointed Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness. Shen Youzhi, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province, became General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Jing Province. Liu Bing, Inspector of Southern Xu, became General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province. Liu Jingsu, Prince of Jianping and newly relieved Grand Steward, became General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，[1]撫軍將軍劉韞有罪免官。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinmao, [1] Liu Yun, General Who Pacifies the Army, was stripped of office for a crime.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the tenth month of winter, [1] General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Yun was dismissed from office for a crime.

sentences.zh: 辛未，護軍將軍褚淵母憂去職。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, left office on account of his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day General Who Protects the Army Chu Yuan left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，新除平西將軍、郢州刺史劉秉為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jihai, Liu Bing, newly relieved as General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the eleventh month Liu Bing, newly relieved as General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，護軍將軍褚淵還攝本任。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, resumed acting in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day General Who Protects the Army Chu Yuan resumed acting in his original post.

sentences.zh: 芮芮國、高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The Rouran and Goguryeo states dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Rouran and Goguryeo presented local products.

sentences.zh: 十二月，索虜寇義陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Northern Barbarians raided Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Northern Wei raided Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，司州刺史王瞻擊破之。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Wang Zhan, Inspector of Si Province, attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Si Province Inspector Wang Zhan attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 元徽元年春正月戊寅朔，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Yuanhui, on the day wuyin, the first of the month, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Yuanhui, wuyin day, the era was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「夫緩法昭恩，裁風茂典，蠲憲貸眚，訓俗彝義。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict said: "Relaxing the law manifests kindness; restraining conduct is a flourishing standard; remitting punishments and pardoning offenses teaches the people enduring righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict declared: "Relaxing the law manifests kindness, restraining conduct is a flourishing standard, and remitting punishments to pardon offenses teaches the people enduring righteousness.

sentences.zh: 朕臨馭宸樞，夤制氓宇，式存寬簡，思孚矜惠。

translations.literal: I preside over the pivot of the throne and extend governance over the realm, wishing to preserve leniency and simplicity and seeking to inspire compassionate grace.
translations.idiomatic: As I preside over the throne and extend governance across the realm, I wish to preserve leniency and simplicity and inspire compassionate grace.

sentences.zh: 今開元肆宥，萬品惟新，凡茲流斥，宜均弘洗。

translations.literal: Now, as the new era opens with broad pardon and the myriad things are renewed, all those banished and expelled should equally receive this broad cleansing.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the new era opens with broad pardon and all things are made new, all who have been banished and expelled should equally receive this cleansing.

sentences.zh: 自元年以前貽罪徙放者，悉聽還本。」

translations.literal: Those who before this first year had lingering crimes and had been exiled or banished are all permitted to return to their original homes."
translations.idiomatic: All those exiled or banished for lingering crimes before this first year are permitted to return home."

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，以晉熙王燮為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yihai, Liu Xie, Prince of Jinxi, was made Inspector of Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the second month the Prince of Jinxi, Liu Xie, was appointed Inspector of Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，以撫軍長史何恢為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingshen, He Hui, Chief Clerk of the General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the third month He Hui, chief clerk to the General Who Pacifies the Army, was appointed Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 婆利國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Varini dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Varini presented local products.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前淮南太守劉靈遺為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Liu Lingyi, former Administrator of Huainan, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day former Huainan Administrator Liu Lingyi was appointed Inspector of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛卯，以輔師將軍李安民為司州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day xinmao, Li Anmin, General Who Assists the Army, was made Inspector of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the fifth month of summer General Who Assists the Army Li Anmin was appointed Inspector of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 丙申，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Prince of Henan dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day envoys from the Prince of Henan presented local products.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，以越州刺史陳伯紹為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renzi, Chen Bishao, Inspector of Yue Province, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the sixth month Yue Province Inspector Chen Bishao was appointed Inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: [2]乙卯，特進、左光祿大夫劉遵考卒。

translations.literal: [2] On the day yimao, Liu Zunkao, Special Advance and Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, died.
translations.idiomatic: [2] On yimao day Special Advance and Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Liu Zunkao died.

sentences.zh: 壽陽大水，己未，遣殿中將軍賑卹慰勞。

translations.literal: Shouyang suffered great flooding. On the day jiwei, a Palace Interior General was dispatched to grant relief, comfort, and consolation.
translations.idiomatic: After great flooding at Shouyang, on jiwei day a Palace Interior General was sent to grant relief and offer consolation.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以左軍將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Meng Ciyang, General of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day General of the Left Army Meng Ciyang was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，散騎常侍顧長康、長水校尉何翌之表上所撰諫林，上自虞、舜，下及晉武，凡十二卷。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingchou, Gu Kaizhi, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, and He Yizhi, Colonel Director of Retainers, submitted memorials presenting their compiled Forest of Remonstrance, from Yu and Shun above down to Emperor Wu of Jin below, twelve fascicles in all.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the seventh month of autumn Gu Kaizhi, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, and He Yizhi, Colonel Director of Retainers, submitted their compiled Forest of Remonstrance in twelve fascicles, covering rulers from Yu and Shun down to Emperor Wu of Jin.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，詔曰：「分方正俗，著自虞冊，川谷異制，煥乎姬典。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinhai, an edict said: "Assigning districts and rectifying custom was set forth in the records of Yu; differing institutions for valleys and rivers shine forth in the Zhou canon.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the eighth month an edict declared: "Assigning districts and rectifying custom was established in Yu's records, and differing institutions for valleys and rivers shine forth in the Zhou canon.

sentences.zh: 故井遂有辨，閭伍無雜，用能七教克宣，八政斯序。

translations.literal: Thus wells and paths had their distinctions and hamlets and neighbors were not mixed, whereby the seven teachings could be fully proclaimed and the eight administrations thereby ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Thus wells and paths were clearly distinguished and neighborhoods were not mixed, enabling the seven teachings to be fully proclaimed and the eight administrations properly ordered.

sentences.zh: 雖綿代殊軌，沿革異儀，或民懷遷俗，或國尚興徙，漢陽列燕、代之豪，關西熾齊、楚之族，並通籍新邑，即居成舊。

translations.literal: Though successive ages followed different tracks and institutions changed with shifting customs, sometimes the people cherished migratory habits and sometimes states prized resettlement — at Hanyang the powerful clans of Yan and Dai were listed, in the lands west of the Pass the families of Qi and Chu flourished, all registering in new settlements yet living as if in their old homes.
translations.idiomatic: Though ages followed different paths and institutions shifted with changing customs, sometimes peoples cherished migration and sometimes states valued resettlement. At Hanyang the great clans of Yan and Dai were enrolled, west of the Pass the families of Qi and Chu flourished — all registering in new settlements yet living as in their old homes.

sentences.zh: 洎金行委御，禮樂南移，中州黎庶，襁負揚、越。

translations.literal: When the Jin dynasty yielded the throne, ritual and music moved south, and the common people of the central provinces carried their infants on their backs to Yang and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin dynasty yielded power, ritual and music moved south, and the common people of the central provinces migrated to Yang and Yue carrying infants on their backs.

sentences.zh: 聖武造運，道一閎區，貽長世之規，申土斷之制。

translations.literal: When sacred martial virtue founded the fortune, the Way unified the vast realm, bequeathing regulations for lasting generations and reasserting the institution of land registration by native soil.
translations.idiomatic: When sacred martial virtue established the dynasty, the Way unified the vast realm, bequeathing regulations for lasting generations and reasserting native land registration.

sentences.zh: 而夷險相因，盈晦遞襲，歲饉凋流，戎役惰散，違鄉寓境，漸至繁積。

translations.literal: Yet ease and hardship succeeded one another, fullness and decline alternated, years of famine thinned and scattered the population, military service bred laxity and dispersion, and living away from one's native district in another jurisdiction gradually piled up in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Yet ease and hardship alternated, abundance and decline succeeded one another, famine years thinned and scattered the people, military service bred laxity, and residence away from one's native district in foreign jurisdictions gradually piled up.

sentences.zh: 宜式遵鴻軌，以為永憲，庶阜俗昌民，反風定保。

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow the great track as an eternal statute, that customs may flourish, the people prosper, and the transforming wind be settled and secured.
translations.idiomatic: The great precedent should be followed as an eternal statute, so that customs may flourish, the people prosper, and transforming influence be settled and secure.

sentences.zh: 夷胥山之險，澄瀚海之波，括河圖於九服，振玉軔於五都矣。

translations.literal: Level the peril of Mount Xu, clarify the waves of the vast sea, gather the river charts within the nine domains, and let the jade shafts of the chariot resound in the five capitals.
translations.idiomatic: Let the peril of Mount Xu be leveled, the waves of the vast sea clarified, the river charts gathered within the nine domains, and the jade chariot shafts resound in the five capitals.

sentences.zh: 」祕書丞王儉表上所撰七志三十卷。

translations.literal: " Secretary Wang Jian submitted a memorial presenting his compiled Seven Records in thirty fascicles.
translations.idiomatic: " Secretary Wang Jian submitted his compiled Seven Records in thirty fascicles.

sentences.zh: 京師旱。

translations.literal: There was drought in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: There was drought in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔曰：「比亢序騫度，留熏燿晷，有傷秋稼，方貽民瘼。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, an edict said: "Prolonged drought has altered the calendar's proper sequence; lingering heat burns the measuring shadow; autumn crops are harmed, to the people's injury.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict declared: "Prolonged drought has disordered the seasonal sequence, lingering heat scorches the days, autumn crops have suffered harm, and the people's distress grows.

sentences.zh: 朕以眇疚，未弘政道，囹圄尚繁，枉滯猶積，夕厲晨矜，每惻于懷。

translations.literal: I, slight and afflicted, have not yet broadened the way of governance; prisons are still numerous and wrongs deferred still accumulate; evening brings distress and morning brings compassion — the sorrow is ever in my breast.
translations.idiomatic: Slight and afflicted, I have not yet broadened governance. Prisons remain crowded, wrongful detentions still accumulate, and morning and evening I feel compassion and sorrow in my heart.

sentences.zh: 尚書令可與執法以下，就訊眾獄，使寃訟洗遂，困弊昭蘇。

translations.literal: The Director of the Masters of Writing, together with those below who enforce the law, should proceed to examine the many prison cases, so that unjust suits may be cleared and the distressed revived.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Masters of Writing, together with judicial officials, should examine all prison cases so that unjust suits may be cleared and the distressed restored.

sentences.zh: 頒下州郡，咸令無壅。

translations.literal: This shall be issued to the provinces and commanderies, all ordered to permit no obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Issue this to all provinces and commanderies with orders that nothing be obstructed.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，鎮軍將軍、南徐州刺史建平王景素進號鎮北將軍。

translations.literal: " On the day guihai, Liu Jingsu, Prince of Jianping, General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was advanced to General Who Guards the North.
translations.idiomatic: " On guihai day the Prince of Jianping, General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu, was promoted to General Who Guards the North.

sentences.zh: 庚午，陳留王曹銑薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Cao Quan, Prince of Chenliu, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Prince of Chenliu, Cao Quan, died.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，詔曰：「國賦氓稅，蓋有恒品，往屬戎難，務先軍實，徵課之宜，或乖昔准。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renwu, an edict said: "State levies and the people's taxes generally have fixed standards. In past times, owing to military hardship, priority was given to military stores, and the appropriateness of collection and imposition sometimes departed from former norms.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the ninth month an edict declared: "State levies and people's taxes should have fixed standards, but in past times, owing to military hardship, military supplies took priority and collection sometimes departed from former norms.

sentences.zh: 湘、江二州，糧運偏積，調役既繁，庶徒彌擾。

translations.literal: In the two provinces of Xiang and Jiang, grain transport had piled up unevenly, corvée and service were already burdensome, and the common laborers were ever more harassed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiang and Jiang Provinces grain transport had piled up unevenly, corvée and service were already burdensome, and the common people were ever more harassed.

sentences.zh: 因循權政，容有未革，民單力弊，歲月愈甚。

translations.literal: Provisional policies carried forward may still have reforms unfinished; the people are depleted in strength and resources, and month by month the distress grows worse.
translations.idiomatic: Provisional policies carried forward may still leave reforms unfinished; the people grow ever weaker, and with each passing month the distress worsens.

sentences.zh: 永言矜歎，情兼宵寐。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of compassion and sighing, the feeling fills both night and sleep.
translations.idiomatic: I sigh constantly in compassion, and the feeling fills my waking and sleeping hours.

sentences.zh: 可遣使到所，明加詳察。

translations.literal: Envoys may be dispatched to the places concerned for clear and thorough investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Let envoys be sent to each place for clear and thorough investigation.

sentences.zh: 其輸違舊令，役非公限者，並即蠲改，具條以聞。

translations.literal: Whatever deliveries violate old ordinances or services exceed public limits shall all at once be remitted or corrected, with each item reported in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Deliveries that violate old ordinances or corvée that exceeds public limits shall all be remitted or corrected at once, with full details reported.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，立衡陽王嶷子伯玉為南平王。

translations.literal: " On the day dinghai, Liu Boyu, son of Liu Yao, Prince of Hengyang, was installed as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: " On dinghai day Liu Boyu, son of the Prince of Hengyang Liu Yao, was installed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，以撫軍司馬王玄載為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day renzi, Wang Xuanzai, Major of the General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Inspector of the two provinces of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the tenth month of winter Wang Xuanzai, major to the General Who Pacifies the Army, was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin Provinces.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，割南兗州之鍾離、豫州之馬頭，又分秦郡、梁郡、歷陽置新昌郡，立徐州。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Zhongli of Southern Yan Province and Matou of Yu Province were detached; Qin, Liang, and Liyang commanderies were further divided to establish Xinchang commandery, and Xu Province was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Zhongli was detached from Southern Yan Province and Matou from Yu Province; Qin, Liang, and Liyang were further divided to form Xinchang Commandery, and Xu Province was established.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以散騎常侍垣閎為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingzi, Yuan Hong, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, was made Inspector of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the eleventh month Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Yuan Hong was appointed Inspector of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，尚書令袁粲母喪去職。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Yuan Can, Director of the Masters of Writing, left office on account of his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day, guimao, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, guimao day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，司空、江州刺史桂陽王休範進位太尉，尚書令袁粲還攝本任，加號衞將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jiang Province, was advanced to Grand Commandant; Yuan Can, Director of the Masters of Writing, resumed acting in his original post and was additionally given the title General of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Prince of Guiyang Liu Xiufan, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jiang Province, was promoted to Grand Commandant; Yuan Can, Director of the Masters of Writing, resumed acting in his original post and was additionally made General of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，立前建安王世子伯融為始安縣王。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Liu Borong, former heir of the Prince of Jian'an, was installed as Prince of Shian county.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Liu Borong, former heir of the Prince of Jian'an, was installed as Prince of Shian.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the Prince of Henan dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day envoys from the Prince of Henan presented local products.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚子，以右光祿大夫張永為征北將軍、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day gengzi, Zhang Yong, Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, was made General Who Campaigns against the North and Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the first month of spring of the second year Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Zhang Yong was appointed General Who Campaigns against the North and Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，加護軍將軍褚淵中軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jisi, Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, was additionally made General of the Center Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the second month General Who Protects the Army Chu Yuan was additionally appointed General of the Center Army.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，以左衞將軍王寬為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guiyou, Wang Kuan, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the third month General of the Left Guard Wang Kuan was appointed Inspector of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，詔曰：「頃列爵敍勳，銓榮酬義，條流積廣，又各淹闕。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guihai, an edict said: "Recently, in listing ranks and recounting merit, weighing honor and repaying righteousness, the categories and streams have piled up broad and wide, yet each has delays and gaps.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the fourth month of summer an edict declared: "Recently, in listing ranks and recounting merit, and weighing honor to repay righteousness, the categories have piled up ever broader, yet each suffers delays and gaps.

sentences.zh: 歲往事留，理至逋壅，在所參差，多違甄飭。

translations.literal: Years pass and affairs linger; reason reaches deferred obstruction; locally there are inconsistencies, and much departs from proper selection and correction.
translations.idiomatic: Years pass while cases linger, justice is deferred and obstructed, local practice is inconsistent, and much departs from proper review and correction.

sentences.zh: 賞未均洽，每疚厥心。

translations.literal: Rewards have not been evenly applied, and each time this afflicts my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards have not been evenly applied, and this afflicts my heart each time.

sentences.zh: 可悉依舊准，並下注職。」

translations.literal: All may follow the old standards and note each rank and office below."
translations.idiomatic: Let all follow the former standards and record rank and office accordingly."

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，[3]太尉、江州刺史桂陽王休範舉兵反。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renwu, [3] Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, Grand Commandant and Inspector of Jiang Province, raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the fifth month, [3] Grand Commandant and Jiang Province Inspector Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, raised troops in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, martial law was proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day martial alert was proclaimed inside and outside the palace.

sentences.zh: 加中領軍劉勔鎮軍將軍，加右衞將軍齊王平南將軍，前鋒南討，出屯新亭。

translations.literal: Liu Mian, Central Palace Guard Commander, was additionally made General Who Guards the Army; the Prince of Qi, General of the Right Guard, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the South; the vanguard marched south to campaign and encamped at Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mian as Central Palace Guard Commander was additionally made General Who Guards the Army, and the Prince of Qi as General of the Right Guard was additionally made General Who Pacifies the South. The vanguard marched south to campaign and encamped at Xinting.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍張永屯白下，前南兗州刺史沈懷明戍石頭，衞將軍袁粲、中軍將軍褚淵入衞殿省。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong, General Who Campaigns against the North, encamped at Baixia; Shen Huaiming, former Inspector of Southern Yan Province, garrisoned Stone City; Yuan Can, General of the Guard, and Chu Yuan, General of the Center Army, entered to guard the palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Campaigns against the North Zhang Yong encamped at Baixia, former Southern Yan Inspector Shen Huaiming garrisoned Stone City, and General of the Guard Yuan Can together with General of the Center Army Chu Yuan entered to guard the palace offices.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賊奄至，攻新亭壘。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the rebels suddenly arrived and attacked the Xinting fort.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the rebels suddenly arrived and attacked the fort at Xinting.

sentences.zh: 齊王拒擊，大破之。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qi repelled the attack and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qi met the attack and inflicted a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 越騎校尉張敬兒斬休範。

translations.literal: Zhang Jinger, Commandant of Elite Cavalry, beheaded Xiufan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jinger, Commandant of Elite Cavalry, beheaded Liu Xiufan.

sentences.zh: 賊黨杜黑蠡、丁文豪分軍向朱雀航，[4]劉勔拒賊敗績，力戰死之。

translations.literal: The rebel partisans Du Heili and Ding Wenhao divided their forces and advanced toward the Zhuque ferry; [4] Liu Mian resisted the rebels but was defeated; fighting to the end he died.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel partisans Du Heili and Ding Wenhao split their forces and marched on the Zhuque ferry. [4] Liu Mian met the rebels, was defeated, and died fighting to the last.

sentences.zh: 右軍將軍王道隆奔走遇害。

translations.literal: Wang Daolong, General of the Right Army, fled and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right Army Wang Daolong was cut down while fleeing.

sentences.zh: 張永潰於白下，沈懷明自石頭奔散。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong was routed at Baixia; Shen Huaiming fled and scattered from Stone City.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong was routed at Baixia, and Shen Huaiming broke and fled from Stone City.

sentences.zh: 甲午，[5]撫軍典籤茅恬開東府納賊，[6]賊入屯中堂。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, [5] Mao Tian, Army Aide of the Pacification Commissioner, opened the Eastern Palace to admit the rebels; [6] the rebels entered and encamped in the Central Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, [5] Mao Tian, Army Aide of the Pacification Commissioner, opened the Eastern Palace to the rebels. [6] The rebels entered and encamped in the Central Hall.

sentences.zh: 羽林監陳顯達擊大破之。

translations.literal: Chen Xianda, Supervisor of the Feathered Forest Guard, attacked and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Xianda, Supervisor of the Feathered Forest Guard, attacked and routed them completely.

sentences.zh: 丙申，張敬兒等破賊於宣陽門、莊嚴寺、小市，進平東府城，梟擒羣賊。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Zhang Jinger and others defeated the rebels at Xuanyang Gate, Zhuangyan Monastery, and Xiaoshi, then advanced to pacify the Eastern Palace city, displaying the captured rebels and seizing them all.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Zhang Jinger and others defeated the rebels at Xuanyang Gate, Zhuangyan Monastery, and Xiaoshi, then advanced to pacify the Eastern Palace city, putting rebel heads on display and capturing the rest.

sentences.zh: 賞賜封爵各有差。

translations.literal: Rewards, grants, and ennoblements were apportioned according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards, gifts, and ennoblements were distributed according to merit.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔京邑二縣埋藏所殺賊，并戰亡者，復同京城。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered the two counties of the capital district to bury the slain rebels and those who died in battle, restoring the same practice as in the capital proper.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered the two capital-district counties to bury slain rebels and those who fell in battle, following the same practice as the capital city.

sentences.zh: 是日解嚴，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。

translations.literal: That same day martial alert was lifted, a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven, and civil and military officials received one rank of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: That same day martial alert was lifted, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，原除江州逋債，其有課非常調、役為民蠹者，悉皆蠲停。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, overdue debts in Jiang Province were forgiven in full; irregular levies and corvée that had become a plague upon the people were all remitted and halted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day all overdue debts in Jiang Province were remitted, and irregular taxes and corvée that had become a scourge on the people were abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「頃國賦多騫，公儲罕給。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Recently state tax revenues have fallen far short, and the public granaries rarely suffice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Of late state revenues have fallen far short and the public granaries scarcely suffice.

sentences.zh: 近治戎雖淺，而軍費已多，廩藏虛罄，難用馭遠。

translations.literal: Though recent military affairs have been brief, military expenditures have already grown great; the granaries stand empty and exhausted, making it hard to govern distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: Though recent campaigns have been brief, military costs have already mounted; the storehouses stand empty, and it is hard to govern distant regions.

sentences.zh: 宜矯革淫長，務在節儉。

translations.literal: Extravagance and excess should be corrected; the effort must lie in thrift.
translations.idiomatic: Extravagance and excess must be corrected, and the effort must lie in austerity.

sentences.zh: 其供奉服御，悉就減撤，雕文靡麗，廢而勿修。

translations.literal: Palace provisions and imperial accoutrements should all be reduced and cut back; ornate and lavish decoration should be abandoned and not restored.
translations.idiomatic: Palace provisions and imperial furnishings should all be reduced; ornate and lavish decoration should be abandoned and not restored.

sentences.zh: 凡諸游費，一皆禁斷，外可詳為科格。

translations.literal: All miscellaneous recreational expenditures are forbidden without exception; outside the palace detailed regulations may be drafted accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: All miscellaneous recreational spending is forbidden without exception; detailed regulations may be drafted outside the palace accordingly."

sentences.zh: 」荊州刺史沈攸之、南徐州刺史建平王景素、郢州刺史晉熙王燮、湘州刺史王僧虔、雍州刺史張興世並舉義兵赴京師。

translations.literal: Jiang Province Inspector Shen Youzhi, Southern Xu Inspector Liu Jingsu, Prince of Jianping, Ying Province Inspector Liu Xie, Prince of Jinxi, Xiang Province Inspector Wang Sengqian, and Yong Province Inspector Zhang Xingshi all raised righteous armies and marched to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Province Inspector Shen Youzhi, Southern Xu Inspector Liu Jingsu Prince of Jianping, Ying Province Inspector Liu Xie Prince of Jinxi, Xiang Province Inspector Wang Sengqian, and Yong Province Inspector Zhang Xingshi all raised loyal armies and marched to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以第七皇弟友為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the seventh imperial younger brother You was made Inspector of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the seventh imperial younger brother, You, was appointed Inspector of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，以平南將軍齊王為中領軍、鎮軍將軍、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengzi, the Prince of Qi, General Who Pacifies the South, was made Central Palace Guard Commander, General Who Guards the Army, and Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the sixth month the Prince of Qi, General Who Pacifies the South, was made Central Palace Guard Commander and General Who Guards the Army, and appointed Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，晉熙王燮遣軍剋尋陽，江州平。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Liu Xie, Prince of Jinxi, dispatched troops to capture Xunyang; Jiang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Liu Xie, Prince of Jinxi, sent troops to take Xunyang, and Jiang Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以淮南太守任農夫為豫州刺史，右將軍、南豫州刺史王寬進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Ren Nongfu, Administrator of Huainan, was made Inspector of Yu Province; Wang Kuan, General of the Right and Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Ren Nongfu, Administrator of Huainan, was appointed Inspector of Yu Province, and Wang Kuan, General of the Right and Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改輔師將軍還為輔國。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the title General Who Assists the Army was changed back to General Who Assists the State.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the title General Who Assists the Army was restored to General Who Assists the State.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，立第七皇弟友為邵陵王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day gengchen, the seventh imperial younger brother You was invested as Prince of Shaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the seventh month of autumn the seventh imperial younger brother, You, was invested as Prince of Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以撫軍司馬孟次陽為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Meng Ciyang, Army Aide of the Pacification Commissioner, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Meng Ciyang, Army Aide of the Pacification Commissioner, was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鎮西將軍、荊州刺史沈攸之進號征西大將軍，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史建平王景素進號征北將軍，[7]並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Shen Youzhi, General Who Guards the West and Jiang Province Inspector, was promoted to Grand General Who Campaigns against the West; Liu Jingsu, Prince of Jianping, General Who Guards the North and Southern Xu Inspector, was promoted to General Who Campaigns against the North; [7] both received Grand Marshal status with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Shen Youzhi, General Who Guards the West and Jiang Province Inspector, was promoted to Grand General Who Campaigns against the West, and Liu Jingsu, Prince of Jianping, General Who Guards the North and Southern Xu Inspector, was promoted to General Who Campaigns against the North. [7] Both were granted Grand Marshal status with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 征虜將軍、郢州刺史晉熙王燮進號安西將軍，前將軍、湘州刺史王僧虔進號平南將軍。

translations.literal: Liu Xie, Prince of Jinxi, General Who Subdues Barbarians and Ying Province Inspector, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West; Wang Sengqian, General of the Forward and Xiang Province Inspector, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xie, Prince of Jinxi, General Who Subdues Barbarians and Ying Province Inspector, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West, and Wang Sengqian, General of the Forward and Xiang Province Inspector, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，以征虜行參軍劉延祖為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinyou, Liu Yanzu, Acting Army Aide of the General Who Subdues Barbarians, was made Inspector of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eighth month Liu Yanzu, Acting Army Aide of the General Who Subdues Barbarians, was appointed Inspector of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，以游擊將軍呂安國為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renchen, Lu Anguo, General of Mobile Strikes, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the ninth month Lu Anguo, General of Mobile Strikes, was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以尚書令、新除衞將軍袁粲為中書監，即本號開府儀同三司，領司徒，加護軍將軍褚淵尚書令，撫軍將軍、揚州刺史安成王進號車騎將軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Yuan Can, Minister Over the Masses and newly appointed General of the Guard, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and granted Grand Marshal status with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies under his existing title, and additionally served as Minister of State; Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, was additionally made Minister Over the Masses; the Prince of Ancheng, Pacification Commissioner and Yang Province Inspector, was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Yuan Can, Minister Over the Masses and newly appointed General of the Guard, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and granted Grand Marshal status with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies under his existing title, while also serving as Minister of State. Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, was additionally made Minister Over the Masses, and the Prince of Ancheng, Pacification Commissioner and Yang Province Inspector, was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，以新除侍中王蘊為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day gengshen, Wang Yun, newly appointed Palace Attendant, was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the tenth month of winter Wang Yun, newly appointed Palace Attendant, was appointed Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以游擊將軍陳顯達為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Chen Xianda, General of Mobile Strikes, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Chen Xianda, General of Mobile Strikes, was appointed Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，御加元服，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingxu, the emperor underwent the capping ceremony and a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the eleventh month the emperor underwent the capping ceremony and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 賜民男子爵一級；

translations.literal: Common men were granted one rank of nobility;
translations.idiomatic: Common men were granted one rank of nobility;

sentences.zh: 為父後及三老孝悌力田者爵二級；

translations.literal: those who head their father's lineage, the Three Elders, the Filial and Brotherly, and the Merit Farmers received two ranks of nobility;
translations.idiomatic: heads of households, the Three Elders, the Filial and Brotherly, and Merit Farmers received two ranks of nobility;

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨篤癃不能自存者，穀人五斛；

translations.literal: widowers, widows, orphans, solitaries, and the severely disabled who could not support themselves received five hu of grain per person;
translations.idiomatic: widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, and the severely disabled who could not support themselves received five hu of grain each;

sentences.zh: [8]年八十以上，加帛一匹。

translations.literal: [8] those eighty years of age and above received an additional bolt of silk.
translations.idiomatic: [8] those eighty years of age and above received an additional bolt of silk.

sentences.zh: 大酺五日；

translations.literal: a grand feast was granted for five days;
translations.idiomatic: a grand public feast was granted for five days;

sentences.zh: 賜王公以下各有差。

translations.literal: princes, dukes, and all ranks below received gifts according to station.
translations.idiomatic: princes, dukes, and officials of all ranks received gifts according to station.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，立第八皇弟躋為江夏王，第九皇弟贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guihai, the eighth imperial younger brother Ji was invested as Prince of Jiangxia and the ninth imperial younger brother Zan as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the twelfth month the eighth imperial younger brother, Ji, was invested as Prince of Jiangxia and the ninth, Zan, as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊、明堂。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the day xinsi of the first month, the emperor personally offered sacrifice at the Southern Altar and Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year, on xinsi day of the first month, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Altar and Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingyin, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the third month the King of Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以車騎將軍張敬兒為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Zhang Jinger, General of Chariots and Cavalry, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Zhang Jinger, General of Chariots and Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 其日，京師大水，遣尚書郎官長檢行賑賜。

translations.literal: That same day the capital suffered great flooding; Palace Gentlemen of the Masters of Writing were dispatched to inspect and grant disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the capital was struck by severe flooding; Palace Gentlemen of the Masters of Writing were sent out to inspect the damage and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊戌，詔曰：「頃民俗滋弊，國度未殷，歲時屢騫，編戶不給。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day wuxu, an edict said: "Recently popular custom has grown ever more debased, the state treasury is not abundantly stocked, year after year revenues fall short, and registered households cannot make ends meet.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuxu day, an edict declared: "Of late popular custom has grown ever more debased, the state treasury is not full, revenues fall short year after year, and registered households cannot make ends meet.

sentences.zh: 且邊虞尚警，徭費彌繁，永言夕惕，寢興增疚。

translations.literal: Moreover frontier alarms still warn of danger, and corvée levies grow ever heavier; speaking of it always through the evening I am vigilant, and waking or sleeping my distress increases.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the frontier still warns of danger and corvée levies grow ever heavier; evening and night I speak of it in vigilance, and waking or sleeping my distress only grows.

sentences.zh: 思弘豐耗之制，以惇約素之風，庶偫蓄拯民，以康治道。

translations.literal: I intend to expand the system of abundance and frugality, to foster a spirit of simplicity and restraint, hoping to store reserves and save the people, and thereby set the Way of governance at ease.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to enlarge the system of plenty and frugality and foster a spirit of simplicity, hoping to build reserves, relieve the people, and set governance at ease.

sentences.zh: 太官珍膳，御府麗服，諸所供擬，一皆減撤，可詳為其格，務從簡衷。」

translations.literal: Delicate fare from the Grand Kitchen, sumptuous robes from the Imperial Wardrobe — all provisions and supplies are to be reduced and cut back; detailed regulations may be drafted accordingly, with effort concentrated on simplicity and the mean."
translations.idiomatic: Delicate fare from the Grand Kitchen and sumptuous robes from the Imperial Wardrobe — all provisions and supplies are to be reduced; detailed regulations may be drafted accordingly, with every effort kept to simplicity and moderation."

sentences.zh: 夏四月，遣尚書郎到諸州檢括民戶，窮老尤貧者，蠲除課調；

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Palace Gentlemen of the Masters of Writing were dispatched to the various provinces to inspect and register households; for the desperately old and poorest, tax levies were remitted;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Palace Gentlemen of the Masters of Writing were sent to the provinces to inspect and register households; for the desperately old and poorest, tax levies were remitted;

sentences.zh: 丁壯猶有生業，隨宜寬申；

translations.literal: for adult males who still had livelihoods, leniency was applied as appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: for able-bodied men who still had livelihoods, leniency was applied as appropriate;

sentences.zh: 貲財足以充限者，督令洗畢。

translations.literal: for those whose assets sufficed to meet quotas, they were urged to complete payment in full.
translations.idiomatic: for those whose assets met the required quotas, they were pressed to complete payment in full.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕幸中堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the emperor visited the Central Hall to hear legal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the emperor visited the Central Hall to hear legal cases.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，北國使至。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guiwei, envoys from the Northern State arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the sixth month envoys from the Northern State arrived.

sentences.zh: 兼司徒袁粲、尚書令褚淵並固讓。

translations.literal: Yuan Can, Acting Minister of State, and Chu Yuan, Minister Over the Masses, both firmly declined their appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Can, Acting Minister of State, and Chu Yuan, Minister Over the Masses, both firmly declined office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，以粲為尚書令。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day gengxu, Yuan Can was made Minister Over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the seventh month of autumn Yuan Can was appointed Minister Over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以給事黃門侍郎劉懷珍為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Liu Huaizhen, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat, was made Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Liu Huaizhen, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat, was appointed Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，[9]加護軍將軍褚淵中書監。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengzi, [9] Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, was additionally made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the eighth month, [9] Chu Yuan, General Who Protects the Army, was additionally made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，征西大將軍河南王吐谷渾拾夤進號車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingchen, Tuyuhun Shibin, King of Henan and Grand General Who Campaigns against the West, was promoted to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the ninth month Tuyuhun Shibin, King of Henan and Grand General Who Campaigns against the West, was promoted to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingxu, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the tenth month of winter the state of Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，以冠軍將軍姚道和為司州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yichou, Yao Daohé, General Who Quells the Enemy, was made Inspector of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the twelfth month Yao Daohé, General Who Quells the Enemy, was appointed Inspector of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月已亥，車駕躬耕籍田，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the day jihai of the first month, the emperor personally plowed the sacrificial fields and a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, on jihai day of the first month, the emperor personally plowed the sacrificial fields and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 賜力田爵一級；

translations.literal: Merit farmers were granted one rank of nobility;
translations.idiomatic: Merit farmers were granted one rank of nobility;

sentences.zh: 貸貧民糧種。

translations.literal: seed grain was loaned to the impoverished commoners.
translations.idiomatic: seed grain was loaned to impoverished commoners.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以梁、南秦二州刺史王玄載為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Wang Xuanzai, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Wang Xuanzai, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，以步兵校尉范栢年為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renxu, Fan Bonian, Commandant of Footsoldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the second month Fan Bonian, Commandant of Footsoldiers, was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，加金紫光祿大夫王琨特進。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Wang Kun, Grand Master of the Golden Bell and Purple Radiance, was granted Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Wang Kun, Grand Master of the Golden Bell and Purple Radiance, was granted Special Advancement.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，以寧朔將軍武都王楊文度為北秦州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, Yang Wende, Prince of Wudu and General Who Pacifies the Northlands, was made Inspector of Northern Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Yang Wende, Prince of Wudu and General Who Pacifies the Northlands, was appointed Inspector of Northern Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 乙未，尚書右丞虞玩之表陳時事曰：

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Yu Wanzhi, Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, memorialized on current affairs, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Yu Wanzhi, Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, submitted a memorial on current affairs, saying:

sentences.zh: 天府虛散，垂三十年。

translations.literal: The imperial treasury stands empty and depleted; nearly thirty years have passed.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial treasury has stood empty and depleted for nearly thirty years.

sentences.zh: 江、荊諸州，稅調本少，自頃以來，軍募多乏。

translations.literal: In Jiang and Jing provinces tax levies were already scant; since recently military recruiting has often fallen short.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Jing provinces already yielded scant tax revenue, and of late military recruiting has often fallen short.

sentences.zh: 其穀帛所入，折供文武。

translations.literal: The grain and cloth that do enter are diverted to supply civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: What grain and cloth do come in are diverted to supply civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 豫、兗、司、徐，開口待哺，西北戎將，裸身求衣。

translations.literal: In Yu, Yan, Si, and Xu provinces mouths gape awaiting sustenance; northwestern frontier generals stand naked seeking garments.
translations.idiomatic: In Yu, Yan, Si, and Xu provinces people wait with open mouths for food, while northwestern frontier generals go naked seeking clothes.

sentences.zh: 委輸京都，蓋為寡薄。

translations.literal: What is forwarded to the capital is, in sum, scant and thin.
translations.idiomatic: What reaches the capital is, in all, scant and thin.

sentences.zh: 天府所資，唯有淮、海。

translations.literal: The imperial treasury relies on nothing but the Huai and the sea coast.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial treasury depends on nothing but the Huai region and the sea coast.

sentences.zh: 民荒財單，不及曩日。

translations.literal: The people are destitute and resources meager, falling short of former days.
translations.idiomatic: The people are destitute and resources thin, falling far short of former days.

sentences.zh: 而國度弘費，[10]四倍元嘉。

translations.literal: Yet state expenditures are vast, [10] four times those of the Yuanjia era.
translations.idiomatic: Yet state expenditures are enormous, [10] four times what they were in the Yuanjia era.

sentences.zh: 二衞臺坊人力，五不餘一；

translations.literal: Manpower in the Two Guards' platform offices: not one in five remains;
translations.idiomatic: Manpower in the Two Guards' platform offices: fewer than one in five remain;

sentences.zh: 都水材官朽散，十不兩存。

translations.literal: timber officers of the Directorate of Waterways — rotten and scattered, not two in ten survive.
translations.idiomatic: timber officers of the Directorate of Waterways are rotten and scattered; not two in ten survive.

sentences.zh: 備豫都庫，材竹俱盡；

translations.literal: in the reserve capital stores, timber and bamboo are entirely exhausted;
translations.idiomatic: in the reserve capital stores timber and bamboo are entirely exhausted;

sentences.zh: 東西二𡍒，塼瓦雙匱。

translations.literal: the eastern and western kilns — both brick and tile stores stand empty.
translations.idiomatic: the eastern and western kilns — stores of brick and tile alike stand empty.

sentences.zh: 敕令給賜，悉仰交市。

translations.literal: imperial grants and gifts all depend on market purchase.
translations.idiomatic: imperial grants and gifts all depend on purchases from the market.

sentences.zh: 尚書省舍，日就傾頹，第宅府署，類多穿毀。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing offices daily draw nearer to collapse; mansions and government bureaus for the most part are riddled with damage.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing offices daily draw nearer to ruin; mansions and government bureaus are for the most part riddled with damage.

sentences.zh: 視不遑救，知不暇及。

translations.literal: Seeing it, there is no leisure to rescue; knowing it, there is no time to attend.
translations.idiomatic: One sees it but has no leisure to rescue it; one knows it but has no time to attend to it.

sentences.zh: 尋所入定調，用恒不周，既無儲畜，理至空盡。

translations.literal: Looking to the fixed annual levies — their use is perpetually insufficient; with no reserves stored up, reason leads to utter emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: Looking to the fixed annual levies, their use is perpetually insufficient; with no reserves stored up, the treasury must inevitably run empty.

sentences.zh: 積弊累耗，鍾於今日。

translations.literal: Accumulated abuses and layered waste have culminated in the present day.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated abuses and layered waste have brought us to the present crisis.

sentences.zh: 昔歲奉敕，課以揚、徐眾逋，凡入米穀六十萬斛，錢五千餘萬，布絹五萬匹，雜物在外，賴此相贍，故得推移。

translations.literal: Last year by imperial order Yang and Xu provinces' overdue levies were collected; in all there entered six hundred thousand hu of grain, more than fifty million in coin, fifty thousand bolts of cloth and silk, and miscellaneous goods besides — relying on this to mutual support, the state was barely able to keep going.
translations.idiomatic: Last year, by imperial order, overdue levies from Yang and Xu provinces were collected; in all there came six hundred thousand hu of grain, more than fifty million in coin, fifty thousand bolts of cloth and silk, and miscellaneous goods besides. Relying on this to make ends meet, the state has barely kept going.

sentences.zh: 即今所懸轉多，興用漸廣，深懼供奉頓闕，軍器輟功，將士飢怨，百官騫祿。

translations.literal: But now what is owed grows ever greater and expenditures steadily broaden; I deeply fear palace provisions will suddenly fall short, military armaments will halt mid-work, officers and soldiers will hunger and resent, and all officials will suffer salary cuts.
translations.idiomatic: But now what is owed grows ever greater and expenditures steadily widen; I deeply fear palace provisions will suddenly run out, military armaments will halt mid-work, officers and soldiers will hunger and grow resentful, and all officials will see their salaries cut.

sentences.zh: 署府謝雕麗之器，土木停緹紫之容，國戚無以贍，勳求無以給。

translations.literal: Government offices would lack carved and lavish implements; building works would cease their purple-trimmed splendor; imperial kin would have nothing to live on; those seeking merit rewards would have nothing given them.
translations.idiomatic: Government offices would lack carved and lavish implements; building works would cease their purple-trimmed splendor; imperial kin would have nothing to live on; and those owed merit rewards would receive nothing.

sentences.zh: 如愚管所慮，不月則歲矣。

translations.literal: As this foolish office foresees, it will be not months but a year.
translations.idiomatic: As this humble office foresees, the crisis will come not in months but within a year.

sentences.zh: 經國遠謀，臣所不敢言，朝夕祗勤，心存於匪懈。

translations.literal: Grand statecraft and long-range planning — your subject dares not speak of these; morning and evening I reverently strive, keeping in mind relentless diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Grand statecraft and long-range planning — your subject dares not speak of these; morning and evening I strive in reverent service, keeping in mind tireless diligence.

sentences.zh: 起伏震遽，事屬冒聞。

translations.literal: Rising and bowing in haste, the matter belongs to presumptuous reporting.
translations.idiomatic: Rising and bowing in haste, I report what may be presumptuous to bring before you.

sentences.zh: 伏願陛下留須臾之鑒，垂永代之計，發不世之詔，施必行之典。

translations.literal: I humbly wish Your Majesty would pause for a moment's scrutiny, bestow a plan for perpetual generations, issue an edict without parallel in the age, and enact regulations that must be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish Your Majesty would pause for a moment's scrutiny, bestow a plan for generations to come, issue an edict without parallel in the age, and enact regulations that must be carried out.

sentences.zh: 則氓隸齊歡，[11]高卑同泰。

translations.literal: Then commoners and servants alike would rejoice, [11] high and low sharing in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Then commoners and servants alike would rejoice, [11] high and low sharing in peace.

sentences.zh: 帝優詔答之。

translations.literal: The emperor replied with a gracious edict.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied with a gracious edict.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以驍騎將軍曹欣之為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Cao Xinzhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Inspector of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Cao Xinzhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，加鎮軍將軍齊王尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, the Prince of Qi, General Who Guards the Army, was additionally made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the sixth month the Prince of Qi, General Who Guards the Army, was additionally made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，立第十皇弟翽為南陽王，第十一皇弟嵩為新興王，第十二皇弟禧為始建王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingmao, the tenth imperial younger brother Hui was invested as Prince of Nanyang, the eleventh imperial younger brother Song as Prince of Xinxing, and the twelfth imperial younger brother Xi as Prince of Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the eighth month the tenth imperial younger brother, Hui, was invested as Prince of Nanyang, the eleventh, Song, as Prince of Xinxing, and the twelfth, Xi, as Prince of Shijian.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以給事黃門侍郎阮佃夫為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Ruan Tianfu, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Ruan Tianfu, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat, was appointed Inspector of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以行青、冀二州刺史劉善明為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Liu Shanming, acting Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was appointed Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Liu Shanming, who had been acting Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was confirmed as Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，割郢州之隨郡屬司州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai day, Suo commandery of Ying Province was detached and assigned to Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai day, Suo commandery was detached from Ying Province and placed under Si Province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，驍騎將軍高道慶有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Gao Daoqing, General of Valiant Cavalry, was guilty and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Gao Daoqing, General of Valiant Cavalry, was found guilty and ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 己丑，車騎將軍、揚州刺史安成王進號驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，安西將軍、郢州刺史晉熙王燮進號鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the Prince of Ancheng, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yang Province, was advanced to Grand General of Agile Cavalry with Bountiful Court, Opening Office with ritual equal to the Three Excellencies; the Prince of Jinxi, Xie, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province, was advanced to General Who Guards the West.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Prince of Ancheng, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yang Province, was promoted to Grand General of Agile Cavalry with Bountiful Court, Opening Office with ritual equal to the Three Excellencies, and the Prince of Jinxi, Xie, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Province, was promoted to General Who Guards the West.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，以吏部尚書王僧虔為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinyou day, Wang Sengqian, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the tenth month of winter Wang Sengqian, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 宕昌王梁彌機為安西將軍、河涼二州刺史。

translations.literal: Liang Miji, King of Dangchang, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of He and Liang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Miji, King of Dangchang, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of He and Liang provinces.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，中書監、護軍將軍褚淵母憂去職。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Chu Yuan, Director of the Central Secretariat and General Who Protects the Army, left office on account of his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Chu Yuan, Director of the Central Secretariat and General Who Protects the Army, resigned to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，詔攝本任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengxu day, an edict ordered him to act in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengxu day, an edict ordered him to serve in his former post on an acting basis.

sentences.zh: 五年春二月壬申，以建寧太守柳和為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, in the second month of spring on renshen day, Liu He, Administrator of Jianning, was made Inspector of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on renshen day in the second month of spring, Liu He, Administrator of Jianning, was appointed Inspector of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 四月甲戌，豫州刺史阮佃夫、步兵校尉申伯宗、朱幼謀廢立，佃夫、幼下獄死，伯宗伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on jiaxu day, Ruan Tianfu, Inspector of Yu Province, Shen Bozong and Zhu You, Regiment Commanders of Footsoldiers, plotted deposition and enthronement; Tianfu and You died in prison, and Bozong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiaxu day, Ruan Tianfu, Inspector of Yu Province, and the Footsoldier Regiment Commanders Shen Bozong and Zhu You plotted to depose the emperor and enthrone another. Tianfu and You died in prison, and Bozong was executed.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，以左軍將軍沈景德為交州刺史，驍騎將軍全景文為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jihai day, Shen Jingde, General of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Jiao Province; Quan Jingwen, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the fifth month Shen Jingde, General of the Left Army, was appointed Inspector of Jiao Province, and Quan Jingwen, General of Valiant Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: [12]丙午，以屯騎校尉孫曇瓘為越州刺史。

translations.literal: [12] On bingwu day, Sun Tanjun, Regiment Commander of Hubian Cavalry, was made Inspector of Yue Province.
translations.idiomatic: [12] On bingwu day Sun Tanjun, Regiment Commander of Hubian Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Yue Province.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，誅司徒左長史沈勃、散騎常侍杜幼文、游擊將軍孫超之、長水校尉杜叔文，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu day, Shen Bo, Left Chief Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, Du Youwen, Attendant-in-Ordinary at the Palace Secretariat, Sun Chaozhi, General of Uprooting Attack, and Du Shuwen, Regiment Commander of the Long River, were executed; a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the sixth month Shen Bo, Left Chief Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, Du Youwen, Attendant-in-Ordinary at the Palace Secretariat, Sun Chaozhi, General of Uprooting Attack, and Du Shuwen, Regiment Commander of the Long River, were put to death, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 七月戊子夜，帝殞於仁壽殿，時年十五。

translations.literal: On the night of wuzi day in the seventh month, the emperor died in the Hall of Human Longevity; he was fifteen years old.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi day in the seventh month the emperor died in the Hall of Human Longevity at the age of fifteen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皇太后令曰：

translations.literal: On jichou day, the empress dowager issued an order, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the empress dowager issued an order, saying:

sentences.zh: 衞將軍、領軍、中書監、八座：昱以冢嫡，嗣登皇統，庶其體識日弘，社稷有寄。

translations.literal: To the General of the Guard, Director of Affairs for the Palace Army, Director of the Central Secretariat, and the Eight Ministers: Yu, as eldest legitimate heir, succeeded to the imperial line, and it was hoped his mind and wisdom would daily broaden and the altars of state find their support in him.
translations.idiomatic: To the General of the Guard, the Director of Affairs for the Palace Army, the Director of the Central Secretariat, and the Eight Ministers: Yu, as eldest legitimate heir, had succeeded to the imperial line, and we hoped his understanding would grow day by day and that the altars of state would find their support in him.

sentences.zh: 豈意窮凶極悖，自幼而長，善無細而不違，惡有大而必蹈。

translations.literal: Who could have expected such utmost wickedness and extremity of perversity — from childhood as he grew, no small good but he defied it, no great evil but he must tread it.
